gap: Cost of the adopted v8 online solve: identify the repeated work behind quad update latency without changing the learner or its accuracy recipe.
scope: Read-only saved-session timing diagnosis. All15 package files must remain byte-identical to adopted v8. No new initialization, sequential fitting trajectory, learner optimization, solver budget change, prior change, controller, dense forecast Jacobian, consumer option or platform branch. Replay genuine recorded updates only on disposable clones; never apply diagnostic proposals to a retained session.

points.selection: For each case: initial session genuine next recorded transition; final session retained-cache-only probe; then all existing fixed-wing pre-prediction captures in sorted origin order.35points total:29genuine transitions and6retained-cache probes. No selection by newly measured latency or numerical outcome.
points.genuine_transition: Use the saved prefix/capture cursor, issued command and observed next target, authenticating them against the parent source tape, pre-prediction capture and journal. Reproduce public observe only on fresh disposable clones of this same state, never chaining repeated trials. Compare every resulting core-model fingerprint, report and counters exactly against original v8 assimilation. Clone/load/hash/save are outside timed calls.
points.retained_cache_probe: Final sessions have no next recorded transition. Use their unchanged retained bootstrap/recent cache and saved damping for conditioning/proposal component probes only. Do not repeat the last target or report these probes as actual historical updates. Never call observe for these6points.
points.preparation: One immutable prepared input tuple per point: raw saved parameters/normalizers, newly completed replay cache for genuine next updates (same bounded construction as observe) or existing full cache for final probes, fixed scale/weights/damping, delay and dt. All component inputs stay fixed across repeats. Causal data and parent archives are never modified.

measurement.ambient: Same pinned CPU/arm64 runtime; ambient float32 with explicit float64 optimizer context. No concurrent fits/tests/heavy compute during timing. Record actual runtime and compilation/cache state; do not silently change BLAS/XLA settings.
measurement.order: At each point, run one first/qualification call per scope; then3warmups and21timed repetitions. Rotate the component order left by repetition index deterministically to reduce drift. No outlier deletion or adaptive repeats. Keep every raw sample and first-call timing. First-for-point includes any compile/dispatch cost and is not necessarily cold after earlier shape signatures; record scope signature and first-seen flag.
measurement.synchronization: Parameters/data are dynamic JIT arguments. Fully materialize/synchronize every output array leaf before stopping the clock, including arrays in linearization Partial pytrees. Pre-synchronize fixed inputs before timing. Do not time no-argument closures over model/data constants.
measurement.public_update: For29genuine points, each of25clones executes exactly one unchanged observe. Nested timestamps record observe-only, subsequent public model snapshot plus synchronization, and their legacy combined total matching evaluate_online measurement. No clone/load/save/hash cost within this total.725observe calls planned; discard all clones after validation. No public-update timing for final-cache probes.
measurement.native_scopes: conditioning uses unchanged _recondition; proposal uses unchanged _proposal on fixed conditioned inputs. prior and residual are independently jitted existing functions. Native whole-proposal and public-update timings are authoritative measured scopes, not sums of components.
measurement.cumulative_prefixes: Generate diagnostic functions from the committed _proposal AST, using unchanged statements/arithmetic/order and dynamic arguments. setup returns saved arrays after gradient; solve adds the exact16safeguarded PCG loop; trust adds original trust clipping/current loss/direction validity; instrumented executes the entire proposal and returns original outputs plus these stage checkpoints. Preserve16iterations and actual first-acceptable ladder. Do not change production source. Save generated function source/hashes for audit. Returned intermediates may alter compiler fusion/materialization; label all prefix comparisons diagnostic.
measurement.linearization: A jitted helper returns raw residual and jax.linearize push as a pytree Partial, with its bound residual arrays dynamically passed to cached action kernels. Record tape leaf counts/bytes. This is a timing helper, never persistent learner state. No new dense Jacobian.
measurement.cached_actions: Use fixed initial preconditioned direction p=-g/(A+damping), derived once outside timing. cached_jvp returns Jp from the retained linearization; cached_vjp returns J.T c with c=W*IRLS*Jp; cached_curvature returns J.T W*IRLS Jp+(A+damping)*p. Dynamic retained tape arrays, vectors and weights; no new primal linearization inside these timed actions. These isolate derivative application costs but are not additive production shares.
measurement.host_preparation: Record untimed setup/preparation/load costs separately if useful, never infer host overhead by subtracting independently measured medians. Public observe/snapshot nested timestamps are the only additive split.
measurement.statistics: Per point and scope: count, median,p95,max,min and raw21times; public observe/snapshot/legacy nested series. Group descriptively by family AND point kind without weighting23fixed-wing captures as if representative streams. Ratios solve/setup, trust/solve, instrumented/native and native/public are descriptive non-additive comparisons. A p95 from repeated fixed snapshots is not a fresh real-time trajectory qualification.

qualification.native_replay: All725genuine disposable observe calls must exactly reproduce corresponding original v8 post-assimilation model fingerprint and report/counters. Initialization count0; no new scientific data or parameter selection. Preserve every failure and do not retry numerical failures under another algorithm.

component_numerics.rules: Compare instrumented full output against native proposal; compare each cumulative prefix output against its matching instrumented stage; compare linearization raw against instrumented raw; check cached JVP/VJP adjoint consistency and cached curvature arithmetic. Discrete finite flags, trial count and selected alpha must agree exactly. Float arrays use fixed tolerances with exact finite masks, including unusedNaNtrial slots; report maximum scaled errors. Numerical equivalence is a qualification for interpreting diagnostic timings, not proof an alternative learner preserves predictions.

qualification.source_and_sessions: All15package file hashes must match parent scientific source before/after, every saved session fingerprint unchanged by read-only component probes, all parent payloads/commands/targets/arrays authenticated. Full applicable tests and lean analytic component/harness/tamper tests must pass. Baseline replay need not rerun because all15package files are unchanged and previous exact replay remains bound.
qualification.success: Complete35point profile, exact29point native replay across all repeats, component numerical checks and saved-data verification pass. Identify a bottleneck only if native scope dominance and cumulative/action diagnostics consistently support it; otherwise report unresolved decomposition. No adoption gate or claimed speedup from this read-only iteration.
qualification.failure_policy: Keep attempted points, samples and errors in an exclusive sealed output even on failure. Never loosen frozen tolerances or alter point/repeat roster after measurement. A harness bug may be corrected and committed, but retain failed attempts and distinguish harness failure from numeric failure.

evidence: Commit this protocol before implementing tooling; commit scientific scripts/tests before any real saved-model calls. Seal protocol, source/runtime binding, parent authority/inventory, point inputs and qualified outputs/intermediates, per-call timing arrays, hashes/reports/counters and a summary. Saved-data verification must use no Glassbox/JAX model or optimizer calls: recheck input/session identities, replay identities, frozen point/sample counts, component arrays/tolerances/decisions, raw timing statistics and summary. Independent review checks conclusions and source preservation. Historical trace/reconstruction tools remain pinned; reuse only compatible pure utilities.
next_decision: Choose the next single optimization only after this measured profile; cached learned-history sensitivities, shared measured-feature work and host/snapshot overhead are hypotheses, not selected implementation or promised speedup.
